scope: Forward adoption interpretation of converted catalog evidence; no observed results changed
installed_and_smoked_requires: Vendor-documented native integration for each client, cited at its installed pin and source file/line.
Installed configuration/integration readback through supported scripts, names only and never credential values.
The documented integration gap repaired through its owner; client changes are applied by the command center.
One fresh-session smoke per client using an organic-shaped task whose prompt does not name the tool.
organic_use_requires: One working day of invocation measurement on the integration's native channel; a hook uses hook execution events rather than MCP call counts.
under_invocation: An unwired or uninvoked required tool is an adoption defect to resolve; zero usage does not establish not-needed status.
promotion_limit: Without the cited integration/readback/two-client smoke and subsequent daily report, no slot is adopted. These sweeps and source reviews establish none of those missing steps by themselves.
owner_join: The finalized catalog field contract and adoption synthesis consume this note; each tool's assigned owner supplies its native evidence.
source: The owner's 2026-10-07 adoption rule, applied to the repository's source-vs-native evidence classes in docs/acceptance-evidence-policy.md; component-specific vendor citations remain required from their integration owners.
